rationale: The 15m candles show the oversold bounce is ALREADY underway: price rallied from the 324.44 low to 336.83 and is holding ~335, with 4h RSI at 26.9 and ADX 73 signaling an exhausted, over-extended down-leg. Shorting here at 335 after a ~3% bounce is exactly the account's worst pattern - late short into stretched oversold tape, stopped by continuation - and funding is flat (~0) so the crowded 2.48 L/S offers no squeeze fuel yet. A clean short needs a breakdown below the 331 bounce base or a bounce back into the 340-345 VWAP zone to fade; neither exists now, so this is mid-range chop with negative expectancy. HOLD and wait for the trigger.

reconsider.note: Losing the 331 higher-low base proves the oversold bounce failed and the ADX-73 downtrend has resumed - revives a momentum short toward 324.44 support.
